name: Yamandu Costa & Guitar Orchestra
description: Experience a one-of-a-kind musical fusion as Brazilian guitar virtuoso Yamandu Costa joins the Portuguese Guitar and Mandolin Orchestra. A night of intricate melodies and passionate performance awaits.
longDescription:
On May 30, 2026, Casa da Música hosts a concert featuring Brazilian guitarist Yamandu Costa and the Portuguese Guitar and Mandolin Orchestra. Costa is known for his seven-string guitar technique and compositions that blend various Brazilian musical traditions, including choro, bossa nova, and samba, with classical and jazz influences. The Portuguese Guitar and Mandolin Orchestra, a collective of musicians dedicated to traditional Portuguese string instruments, will perform alongside him. This collaboration aims to present a dialogue between Brazilian and Portuguese musical forms.

Attendees can expect an evening of instrumental music at Casa da Música, a contemporary concert hall in Porto. The performance will showcase the interplay between Costa's improvisational style and the orchestral arrangements. The venue's main concert hall provides a setting for acoustic performances, designed to offer clear sound projection. The audience will consist of individuals interested in world music, guitar performance, and orchestral arrangements.

Tickets for this event are available starting from €15. Casa da Música is located in the Boavista area of Porto, accessible via the Casa da Música metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F), which is directly opposite the venue. Several bus lines also stop nearby. The venue is designed with accessibility features, including ramps and elevators.
